pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

husk_left.desc: the burr's left half (front); the halves meet at x 0. Split open: swing them apart about their pivots near the bottom of the seam

husk_right.desc: the burr's right half (front); the halves meet at x 0. Split open: swing them apart about their pivots near the bottom of the seam

nut.desc: the chestnut body inside the husk, glossy red-brown with its pale base; seen when the husk splits, and left when it falls away

head.desc: the head: a glossy chestnut, small sad eyes, a mouth of fangs, goo at the jaw; pivot at the neck (0, 31.5)

head_roar.desc: roaring, the mouth wide; pivot at the neck (0, 31.5)

head_hurt.desc: eyes squeezed shut; pivot at the neck (0, 31.5)

head_sad.desc: a tear (hesitate, kneel); pivot at the neck (0, 31.5)

head_calm.desc: calm, no fangs or drool (the fallback for King Marron restored); pivot at the neck (0, 31.5)

crown.desc: a small gold crown, tipped with pearls, three rubies; worn askew on the head; pivot at its base

cape.desc: the royal cape behind the husk, crimson with an ermine collar and hem; pivot at the shoulders

leg_front.desc: a short, thick leg and broad foot; pivot at the hip, under the husk

leg_back.desc: a short, thick leg and broad foot, a tone darker; pivot at the hip, under the husk

goo_drip_1.desc: goo drip loop, frame 1 of 3; pivot at the jaw's corner (head x -9.8, y 34.4)

goo_drip_2.desc: goo drip loop, frame 2 of 3; pivot at the jaw's corner (head x -9.8, y 34.4)

goo_drip_3.desc: goo drip loop, frame 3 of 3; pivot at the jaw's corner (head x -9.8, y 34.4)

husk_shard_1.desc: a piece of the husk falling away as the curse breaks (1 of 4); pivot at its middle

husk_shard_2.desc: a piece of the husk falling away as the curse breaks (2 of 4); pivot at its middle

husk_shard_3.desc: a piece of the husk falling away as the curse breaks (3 of 4); pivot at its middle

husk_shard_4.desc: a piece of the husk falling away as the curse breaks (4 of 4); pivot at its middle

chestnut.desc: a falling chestnut (Chestnut Rain); pivot at its middle
